description: This file defines the ApiTester class used for API testing within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the Actor class from Codeception, providing various methods for authenticating, setting headers, and interacting with the API, including login procedures with different OAuth2 grant types, header management for JSON and JSON API content, and some temporary methods for database operations.

classes.name: ApiTester
classes.description: A class extending Actor for API testing, including methods for authentication, content negotiation, and database manipulations specific to SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loginAsAdmin
methods.description: Logs in as an admin user using password grants.

methods.name: loginAsAdminWithPassword
methods.description: Performs login as admin with password grant.

methods.name: loginAsAdminWithClientCredentials
methods.description: Performs login as admin with client credentials grant.

methods.name: loginWithPasswordGrant
methods.description: Performs login via password grant, stores tokens and token type.

methods.name: loginWithClientCredentialsGrant
methods.description: Performs login via client credentials grant, stores tokens and token type.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Stub method presumably for logging out (empty implementation).

methods.name: sendJwtAuthorisation
methods.description: Sets the Authorization header with the current access token.

methods.name: sendJwtContentNegotiation
methods.description: Sets headers for JSON content negotiation.

methods.name: seeJwtContent
methods.description: Verifies that the Content-Type header indicates JWT content.

methods.name: sendJsonApiContentNegotiation
methods.description: Sets headers for JSON API content negotiation.

methods.name: seeJsonApiContentNegotiation
methods.description: Verifies that the Content-Type header indicates JSON API content.

methods.name: seeJsonAPISuccess
methods.description: Asserts the response is JSON and contains no errors.

methods.name: seeJsonApiFailure
methods.description: Asserts the response is JSON and contains errors.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Temporary method to log in using stored credentials; sets authorization and content type headers.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account record in the database, returns the new ID.

methods.name: createContact
methods.description: Creates a new contact record in the database, returns the new ID.

methods.name: deleteBean
methods.description: Deletes a record from a specified table by ID.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a relationship between records based on relationship metadata.
